sqs.late_settlement.doc: Settling with the receipt handle of an earlier receive (the message became visible again and was received a second time), on a standard and a FIFO queue.

fifo.extend_old_handle.message: sqs:ChangeMessageVisibilityBatch failed (receipt_handle_invalid) [ReceiptHandleIsInvalid]: The receipt handle has expired

fifo.ack_old_handle.message: sqs:DeleteMessageBatch failed (receipt_handle_invalid) [ReceiptHandleIsInvalid]: The receipt handle has expired

sqs.native_redrive.doc: SQS moving a message to the dead-letter queue after ``maxReceiveCount`` receives.

sqs.purge.doc: Purging a queue, and purging it again right away (SQS allows one purge per minute).

purge_again.message: sqs:PurgeQueue failed (throttling) [AWS.SimpleQueueService.PurgeQueueInProgress]: Only one PurgeQueue operation on <run>-purge is allowed every 60 seconds.
purge_again.aws_message: Only one PurgeQueue operation on <run>-purge is allowed every 60 seconds.

sqs.retries.doc: A failed attempt retried by visibility after two seconds: receive count, attempt, timing.

sqs.roundtrip.doc: A message with attributes of every type, sent and received with MD5 verification.

sqs.size_limits.doc: Messages exactly at and one byte over the queue limits (a 1 KiB queue and the default).

1k.over_limit.message: message too large: 1025 bytes exceeds the limit of 1024 bytes; enable large payload offloading (claim check) to send bigger messages

default.over_limit.message: message too large: 1048577 bytes exceeds the limit of 1048576 bytes; enable large payload offloading (claim check) to send bigger messages

attributes_count_towards_limit.message: message too large: 1275 bytes exceeds the limit of 1024 bytes; enable large payload offloading (claim check) to send bigger messages

sqs.visibility_limits.doc: Extending a message's visibility up to and past the 12 hour limit.
